title: Send a link
description: Send this member's household a link to complete registration, update the card on file or sign documents. Links expire after seven days.
smsHelp: Texts go only to numbers with notices consent. The gym is charged for each text.
uncertain: We couldn't confirm the send. Check before sending again.
erased: This member's details were erased, so no link can be sent.
errors.sms_no_consent: The recipient hasn't consented to text notices, so the link wasn't texted.
errors.sms_invalid_phone: The recipient needs a valid phone number before a link can be texted.
errors.sms_payer_only: Card update links can only be texted to the payer: the billing phone, or a consenting member at the billing email when there is no billing phone.
errors.household_email_missing: The household has no valid email address. Add one on the household, or show or text the link instead.
errors.email_disabled: Member email is turned off for this gym, so the link wasn't emailed. Turn it on in Settings, or show or text the link instead.
errors.recipient_suppressed: This email address is suppressed, so the link wasn't emailed.
errors.recipient_suppressed_sms: This number has opted out of texts, so the link wasn't texted.
errors.delivery_unavailable: Delivery isn't set up for this channel, so the link wasn't sent.
errors.delivery_failed: The link couldn't be delivered. Try again, or show the link instead.
errors.household_email: The household has no valid email address. Add one on the household, or show or text the link instead.
errors.email_unavailable: The link wasn't emailed. Member email may be turned off, this household's email suppressed, or email delivery not set up.
errors.text_unavailable: Texts can't be sent right now, so the link wasn't texted.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to send links.
errors.failed: The link couldn't be sent. Try again.
